# Primitives — catalog

<!-- Generated by `npm run index` from component headers. Do not edit by hand. -->

Pick by USE WHEN, then read only the chosen file.

- **accordion.tsx** — Expandable Q and A or progressive disclosure. The FAQ backbone.
- **avatar.tsx** — Person or brand image with initials fallback (testimonials, teams).
- **badge.tsx** — Small status or category tag (New, Popular, category chips).
- **button.tsx** — Any clickable action: CTAs, form submits, menu triggers.
- **card.tsx** — Bounded content container: feature blurbs, pricing tiers, list items.
- **dialog.tsx** — Modal overlay: confirmations, detail views, small focused forms.
- **input.tsx** — Single-line text entry in any form.
- **label.tsx** — Accessible caption for a form field. Every input gets one.
- **select.tsx** — Choosing one option from a list in forms.
- **separator.tsx** — Visual divider between content groups.
- **tabs.tsx** — Switching between peer content panes (pricing periods, feature groups).
- **textarea.tsx** — Multi-line text entry (messages, descriptions).
